items.summary: Risk disposition: blocked for public launch, public beta, alert expansion, rights-dependent monetization, affiliate expansion, and advertising. Conditional only for ordinary reversible growth that preserves existing consent, disclosures, provenance, claims, copyright/trademark, platform-policy, and age-sensitive boundaries. Exact decision: keep the gated product private; retain complicated.work and deadlymaracas.com parked; keep external outreach unsent; continue bounded read-only evidence work only. Evidence: upstream API rights for public/commercial reuse are not established; all four legal launch tasks remain open; security, accuracy/freshness, attribution, measurement, and owner gates are blocked; compliance is technical-only with 37 pass, 16 fail, and 6 unknown; operations and fleet-doctor sweeps have no results; revenue covers 2026-09-21 only with $4.92 aggregate commission not attributable to a site. Human counsel is required for upstream rights, jurisdiction-specific privacy treatment, and any rights-dependent monetization or launch decision.

Launch-readiness tracking remains active: 0 of 4 legal tasks are closed and 4 remain open. No task is closable on current evidence. Progress recorded: official API documentation, public terms, support documentation, repository/configuration artifacts, privacy and cookie-policy artifacts, and the private gate are attached; these do not establish redistribution rights or complete processing evidence. Open tasks: searchwoot-legal-source-rights, searchwoot-data-flow-retention, searchwoot-ga4-consent-evidence, and searchwoot-logs-vendors-incident. Next evidence action: attach one consolidated read-only evidence bundle and field-level rights matrix covering provenance, storage, caching, display, derivatives, alerts, attribution, freshness, correction, takedown, identifiers, retention, deletion, access, notification consent, unsubscribe behavior, GA4 settings, log fields, vendor/DPA coverage, and incident/request procedures. Do not send outreach, enable tracking, expand alerts, change the private gate, or expand monetization.

Data-use review dispositions: Woot API deal and price-history data is counsel_required and launch-blocked because rights to fetch, store, transform, display, cache, retain historical derivatives, send alerts, use trademarks, images, prices, and savings claims, or monetize through affiliates or advertising are not established. User alert rules and sync results are evidence_needed because data inventory, retention, deletion, correction, access, processor terms, notification consent, and unsubscribe behavior are not evidenced. GA4 analytics is evidence_needed because deployed consent and withdrawal behavior, GA4 property/data-sharing settings, retention settings, and jurisdictional treatment are not evidenced. Operational logs and Cloudflare hosting data are evidence_needed because log fields, retention/access controls, vendor/DPA coverage, and incident/request procedures are not evidenced. No item is clear or conditionally launchable on current evidence.

Private-site decision: retain complicated.work and deadlymaracas.com parked. Their scaffold or parked state, missing analytics, and failed or unreachable compliance evidence do not support public launch or monetization. Analytics gaps alone do not block ordinary growth on otherwise evidenced live sites. Next evidence action for each private site: complete a timestamped checklist covering reachability, content, disclosures, consent and cookie behavior, privacy and terms, analytics, monetization, claims, provenance, copyright/trademark, platform policy, age-sensitive concerns where applicable, and an explicit retain-parked or bounded-launch decision.
